text: Mitsubishi Corporation, KDDI Corporation and Lawson, Inc. announced a capital and business alliance on 6 February 2024: KDDI would make a tender offer to take Lawson private, after which Mitsubishi Corporation and KDDI would each hold 50% of Lawson's voting rights. KDDI said on 20 August 2024 that the squeeze-out was complete and that KDDI and Mitsubishi Corporation had each obtained a 50% share of Lawson's voting rights.
short: Lawson is held 50/50 by Mitsubishi Corporation and KDDI Corporation.
